info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Carrental Reservations Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: This API enables the cancellation of car rental reservations, facilitating effective management of bookings. Through this endpoint, users can remove reservations that are no longer needed, streamlining the booking process. Typical consumers include car rental agencies and service providers looking to maintain accurate reservation records. The ability to cancel reservations helps optimize fleet availability and improves overall customer satisfaction.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel an active reservation. Ensure that the reservation ID is valid and that the cancellation is within the allowed timeframe.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a reservation. It should contain the details necessary to identify the reservation to be canceled.

204.description: The reservation was successfully canceled, and no additional content is returned.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for cancelling a reservation. It is expected to be a string that contains any relevant information necessary for the cancellation process.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRespons.title: Cancelling Reservation Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the cancellation operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit log for the cancellation operation.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRespons.description: Schema representing the response of a cancellation operation for reservations.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the entry was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit information related to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds. This header indicates the duration from the moment the request was received until the response was generated.
